about: A whole document on the canvas taught as a structured set of lessons: a table of contents, then an explanation for each part.

cases.text: Turn this document into lessons I can study from start to finish.
Build a structured study plan out of the notes I just added.
Make a full curriculum from this file, with a section for each part.
I want to learn everything in this Markdown file step by step, lay it out as a program.
Teach me the whole document as a series of lessons.
Can you break my notes into a syllabus and write up each lesson?
Convierte este archivo en un curso para estudiar.
Make this reading into a proper class I can work through.
